title: The nuclear‐follower association between the zoobenthivorous Asian sheephead wrasse Semicossyphus reticulatus and the piscivorous Japanese amberjack Seriola quinqueradiata
content:
Abstract

This study investigates the foraging association between the Japanese amberjack Seriola quinqueradiata and the Asian sheephead wrasse Semicossyphus reticulatus in Ryotsu Bay, Sado Island, Japan. S. quinqueradiata individuals were found to follow foraging S. reticulatus and feed on prey in the sediment plumes stirred up by S. reticulatus, which indicates that S. quinqueradiata may be an opportunistic follower species. These findings contribute to our understanding of the nuclear-follower foraging associations in typically piscivorous species in middle-latitude regions and highlight the potential behavioural flexibility of S. quinqueradiata.
